_about: Fiber families and approximate transmission ranges, transcribed from the S02 p.6 figure. Ranges are approximate figure values, not product specifications. Link lengths, losses and ratings for a specific cable are NOT given by the sources and must be confirmed by AFS.

notes.text: Robust 100-300 m cables made with low-OH silica fibers are shown for remote industrial process control (Vis-NIR).
Al- and Cu-alloy coated fibers are free of polymer jacket fluorescence for Raman and fluorescence spectroscopy.
CIR fibers carry the IR channel of the ZrO2 ATR + fluorescence combi probe.

fibers.name: Polycrystalline silver-halide IR fiber (PIR)
used_for: MIR ATR in the fingerprint region

notes.text: PIR transmission range 3-16 um matches the fingerprint region of molecular vibrations.
High NA (>0.3) of PIR fibers gives much better coupling with FTIR spectrometers than hollow waveguides.
PIR-fiber FTIR (diamond cone ATR) shown for API in hot polymer extrusion.

fibers.name: Hollow glass waveguide
used_for: laser power delivery (QCL, CO, CO2 lasers)

notes.text: Hollow waveguides have low NA and very poor coupling efficiency with FTIR spectrometers.
